advice_items.quote: My company will do 300 million this year in revenue, right? If I were still doing it all myself, we might do three.
advice_items.summary_en: Master delegation and build an empowered team; doing everything yourself caps growth at a fraction of your potential.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会授权与培养团队，靠自己只能做小生意

advice_items.quote: I can give you skills, but I can't control your mindset. I can't give you passion, I can't give you drive.
advice_items.summary_en: Mindset matters more than skillset because technical skills can be taught, while passion and drive cannot.
advice_items.summary_zh: 心态、激情与驱动力比单纯的技能更关键

advice_items.quote: Don't go out and blow money on that new Rolex, that new Patek, that Ferrari, the new Lambo... invest that money in something that's going to give you an ROI.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid blowing money or taking on debt for watches, supercars, and consumables that generate zero ROI.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别把钱浪费在豪车名表等无回报消费品上

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: No matter how much money you make, you still got to live within your means.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain strict personal spending discipline regardless of how high your income rises.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无论赚多少钱，都必须坚持量入为出

advice_items.quote: Every dollar I made every week had to stay in the company to reduce my debt liabilities... then I still had to build my balance sheet and retained earnings to be able to grow.
advice_items.summary_en: Keep profits inside the business early on to pay down debt, build retained earnings, and self-fund scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把每周利润全额留存企业降负债、筑资产

advice_items.quote: The day you stop growing as a business is the day you begin to die on the vine... your competitors, they're not resting on their laurels.
advice_items.summary_en: Never settle when a business is merely doing okay; continuous growth is required or competitors will overtake you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 企业停止增长之日，便是走向衰败之时

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: Rather than going taking out this loan, you took on all that risk at once and you didn't have the revenue to support it.
advice_items.summary_en: Do not take on large lump-sum loans before you have consistent revenue to support the risk; grow cash flow in small chunks.
advice_items.summary_zh: 营收未稳切勿借大额贷款一次性承担高风险

advice_items.quote: I've learned financial discipline... I learned how to build up a balance sheet in a business, which is imperative.
advice_items.summary_en: Develop rigorous financial discipline and build a strong balance sheet rather than pulling cash out prematurely.
advice_items.summary_zh: 严守财务纪律，夯实公司资产负债表

advice_items.quote: I'm sitting here today and I still own 100% of my business. I never sold off shares of my business to get the money.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid giving up 51%–70% equity for early idea-stage capital; endure lean bootstrapping to keep ownership.
advice_items.summary_zh: 宁可极简生活也守住股权，别过早稀释股份

advice_items.quote: I want to see that you already started hustling, you already started turning some revenue, maybe at a very small level... now we've got proof of concept.
advice_items.summary_en: Start hustling and generating small initial revenue to prove your concept before seeking outside growth capital.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先自己跑通小规模营收，再谈融资扩张

advice_items.quote: I made it all about our customer... by focusing on what was best for our customers, they continue to turn over more and more of their business to us.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize what is best for existing clients so they expand their contracts and trust you with more business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 一切以客户利益为中心，用信任滚大订单

advice_items.quote: Coming in with more of a consultative sales approach where I'm here to see how I can make your business better... make you more profitable and make you more competitive.
advice_items.summary_en: Use a consultative sales approach focused on making the prospect's business more profitable and competitive.
advice_items.summary_zh: 采用顾问式销售，先帮客户提升利润再成交

advice_items.quote: Establish relationships with bankers as fast as possible. You're going to need them if you're going to scale... start establishing those relationships before you have the need.
advice_items.summary_en: Build relationships with bankers early and let them guide your balance-sheet milestones before you urgently need credit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早与银行建立信任关系，为扩张铺平融资路

advice_items.quote: Got them to believe in me, believe in my integrity, my credibility, because they want to be taking risk with people that they believe have strong credibility.
advice_items.summary_en: Establish unimpeachable integrity and follow through on milestones so lenders and partners are willing to bet on you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用诚信与靠谱记录赢得银行和伙伴的信任

advice_items.quote: Get into a group where we're all there to learn and grow and collaborate and share experience with one another. That's probably the one thing if I were to go back to me at 24, 25 years old I would tell myself to do.
advice_items.summary_en: Join a non-soliciting peer group of founders and CEOs to learn from others' experience instead of spending 40 hours solving problems alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 尽早加入纯粹互助、不互相推销的创始人社群

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: Let them have that win, okay, but now start looking long term... let's make it results driven... allow me to earn my margins... by making your business better.
advice_items.summary_en: In tough price negotiations, concede short-term price and tie future margins to measurable ROI and cost savings you deliver.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判遇到压价时，改签与长期业绩挂钩的方案

advice_items.quote: Now I'm at a place where I really want to give back. I love mentoring other people.
advice_items.summary_en: Use your success and passions as a platform to inspire and mentor younger people coming up behind you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 成功后不忘回馈社会，积极指导下一代创业者

advice_items.quote: I had a dream, I had a vision for something that I wanted for myself and at the end of the day it's the number one thing I tell people all the time: believe in yourself and just don't quit.
advice_items.summary_en: Hold onto a clear vision regardless of humble beginnings, believe in yourself, and refuse to quit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚信自己的梦想，永远不要轻言放弃

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身农场且曾靠救济金生活；创业首个大单年化营收达900万美元，因30天账期需垫付约100万美元周转资金，靠21%高息应收账款保理垫资撑过前5周并坚持不分红全额留存再投资。
guests.role_or_title: Founder & Owner, Effects Management Solutions (Labor Force Management)
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要空手套白狼找早期投资人（否则会被拿走51%-70%股权），先低成本跑通最小营收和商业验证；尽量不给自己发工资、过极简生活，用现金流小步滚雪球；尽早与银行建立信任关系，加入不互相推销的创始人同行交流圈，并坚定自信、永不放弃。
